node.label: Civil aviation & airfares
node.summary: Airfare rules, DGCA and airline performance.

facts.text: The Bharatiya Vayuyan Adhiniyam, 2024 replaced the **Aircraft Act, 1934**.
facts.plain: The Bharatiya Vayuyan Adhiniyam, 2024 replaced the Aircraft Act, 1934.

facts.text: Mains angle: market pricing vs consumer protection; 'extraordinary situations' is not defined. The rules followed a PIL by S. Laxminarayan.
facts.plain: Mains angle: market pricing vs consumer protection; 'extraordinary situations' is not defined. The rules followed a PIL by S. Laxminarayan.

facts.text: Airlines must file tariffs with the **DGCA** and show a full fare breakup. Fares have been market-driven since the **Air Corporations Act** was repealed in 1994.
facts.plain: Airlines must file tariffs with the DGCA and show a full fare breakup. Fares have been market-driven since the Air Corporations Act was repealed in 1994.

facts.text: New airfare rules under the **Bharatiya Vayuyan Adhiniyam, 2024** (notified 31 Oct) let the Centre direct airlines on fares in 'extraordinary situations'. There are no fare caps.
facts.plain: New airfare rules under the Bharatiya Vayuyan Adhiniyam, 2024 (notified 31 Oct) let the Centre direct airlines on fares in 'extraordinary situations'. There are no fare caps.

facts.text: Char Dham helicopter operators threatened to suspend services after the DGCA and the Uttarakhand Civil Aviation Development Authority (UCADA) made two pilots mandatory per charter sortie, following an October 30 helicopter crash in Joshimath that killed six.
facts.plain: Char Dham helicopter operators threatened to suspend services after the DGCA and the Uttarakhand Civil Aviation Development Authority (UCADA) made two pilots mandatory per charter sortie, following an October 30 helicopter crash in Joshimath that killed six.

facts.text: The **Uttarakhand Civil Aviation Development Authority (UCADA)** made a **co-pilot** mandatory for helicopters on pilgrimage routes ('two-pilot crew' for all Char Dham charters) and a report after every flight. UCADA CEO: **Prateek Jain**.
facts.plain: The Uttarakhand Civil Aviation Development Authority (UCADA) made a co-pilot mandatory for helicopters on pilgrimage routes ('two-pilot crew' for all Char Dham charters) and a report after every flight. UCADA CEO: Prateek Jain.

facts.text: The **Aircraft Accident Investigation Bureau (AAIB)**, under the Civil Aviation Ministry, investigates air accidents; it was set up in **2012**, separate from the regulator DGCA.
facts.plain: The Aircraft Accident Investigation Bureau (AAIB), under the Civil Aviation Ministry, investigates air accidents; it was set up in 2012, separate from the regulator DGCA.

facts.text: A **Trans Bharat Aviation** helicopter flying Badrinath to Dehradun crashed near **Joshimath** (Chamoli) on 30 Oct, killing six (five Karnataka pilgrims and the pilot); UCADA grounded the operator's fleet; DGCA and **AAIB** are probing. Uttarakhand had more than half of India's 12 helicopter accidents since 2020.

Uttarakhand had more than half of India's 12 helicopter accidents since 2020.

facts.text: **IndiGo** Q2 FY27: net loss narrowed to **₹1,879.1 crore**; fuel costs rose **67.2%**; passenger yield rose 34.3% to ₹6.30; load factor fell to **80.3%**.
facts.plain: IndiGo Q2 FY27: net loss narrowed to ₹1,879.1 crore; fuel costs rose 67.2%; passenger yield rose 34.3% to ₹6.30; load factor fell to 80.3%.
